remarks: CHARMING FARMHOUSE ON 5 ACRES!  This beautiful, well-maintained 3 bedroom home features many updates and a convenient location. The expansive downstairs provides an opportunity for first floor living as not only is there a primary suite, but also a first floor laundry. Stepping into the kitchen you will discover new cabinets and appliances throughout. In addition to the kitchen there is a dining room and a generous living/family room area. Upstairs you will find 2 additional bedrooms. Vinyl siding was installed on the home in 2021, thermal windows throughout are less than 10 years old, electric hot water heater within the past 5 years and the electrical panel was updated 6 years ago. Moving outside you will find a 1 car detached garage with electric and a newer roof, as well as a 6 year old pole barn measuring 28' x 32' that features electric and heat!!!! Septic system was installed 6 years ago insuring worry free occupation.(Ring doorbell system will be removed prior to occupation by new owner)
